en.title: 26 Bangladeshis identified after Riyadh strike
en.text: The Houthi missile attack on Riyadh airport has affected Bangladeshi citizens. 26 have been identified so far in connection with the incident.

en.text: A Dhaka University professor staged a silent protest demanding academic freedom and professor rights.

en.text: Four people arrested in Dhaka for vandalizing Rabindranath Tagore wall art at Shilpakala Academy.
